objective: Preserve full-v2 chord/boundary accuracy while removing false or unsupported chord changes, decoder-only (no retraining).
parameterPolicy: Scalar switch/duration/boundary dials below are frozen a-priori and are NOT tuned on p01-p05 development metrics. Data-derived parameters (minimum dwell, segment minimum, confirmation frames, flicker thresholds) are computed at evaluation time from OTHER model-selection performers only (never the held-out fold, never p00) via ml.evaluation.segmental.priors.

candidates.description: Frozen full-v2 decoder: EMA probability smoothing (alpha 0.65, boundaryAlpha 0.35) then uniform-penalty Viterbi at the production-parity transition penalty 4.0. Reference point, not a replacement candidate; reproduces the frozen full-v2 aggregate.
Duration-constrained Viterbi: stickier base cost plus a soft short-dwell penalty ramping to zero by the 25th-percentile reference chord duration.
Boundary-gated Viterbi: switch cost reduced by boundary evidence but never below a floor, so the boundary head cannot force a transition alone.
Duration constraint plus boundary gating combined.
Semi-Markov segment decoder: one chord explains a whole bounded segment; short-segment duration prior from other-performer reference durations.
Semi-Markov segment decoder with boundary-gated segment starts.
Full segmental decoder: semi-Markov chord+boundary decode, chord-evidence confirmation, and flicker reconciliation (merge unsupported A->B->A only).
